results.final_text: When I arrive, I may have to look for an empty desk.
results.point_context:
### One Voice: The worker who wants a desk to return to

Every morning, I arrive and look for an empty desk. Yesterday, someone else may have used it. I have nowhere to leave my papers or personal things, and I do not know what I will find on the keyboard or desk surface. When I had the same desk, drawer, and view, I could start work without searching. That steady beginning helped me focus and made the office feel like somewhere I belonged. On paper, I can choose any desk. In practice, I may want one place I can count on.
